events.title: Table of Truth 24/7 Live Stream - Gameplay Showcase
events.summary: Welcome to the 24/7 live stream of Table of Truth!In this continuous broadcast, you can watch various content creators dive into earlier builds of our game, experiencing the core chaotic multiplayer matches.As an independent studio, your support means everything to us. The absolute best way to help our game grow and gain visibility on Steam is by adding it to your Wishlist.Enjoy the stream, and don't forget to Wishlist Table of Truth to support our development journey!

events.title: 🔧 HOTFIX #4 - 🪑 Spawn Fix (Why Was Everyone Sitting on Each Other?)
events.summary: It turns out the networking framework believed every player belonged at the legendary coordinates (0, 0, 0) before finding their actual seat. The result? Everyone briefly merged into one very uncomfortable multiplayer creature.We finally convinced it otherwise, and players should now spawn directly in their assigned seats.If this bug somehow decides to make a comeback, don't worry—we'll keep hunting it down until it's completely gone. events.title: Patch Notes #1 – Multiplayer Fixes ⭐
events.summary: Hey everyone!We've been listening to your reports and this patch tackles some of the most frustrating multiplayer issues. Here's what changed:🪑 Spawn fix — Players no longer sit on top of each other Invited players were being placed at the same spot instead of their assigned seats. This was caused by Mirror's snapshot interpolation overriding the spawn position before it could settle. events.summary: Hey everyone!Quick update with a few fixes:🪑 Seating fix — Players now correctly appear in their assigned seats when joining the lobby instead of spawning in random positions.🎥 Black screen fix — The camera now properly transitions when the game starts.
